name: Oat Porridge
description:
Oats cooked slowly in water until they thicken, finished with a small pinch of salt. The bowl is plain, filling and warm from the morning pot.

Sold as one individual breakfast portion. Price and weight cover the named food only; plates, bowls and cutlery remain with the inn. Drinks and unlisted sides are separate. This meal grants no automatic healing or resting bonus.
